digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler jira adapter module restructuring
propositions: Eight jira-specific modules must be physically relocated from package root to adapters/jira/ without re-export shims
The file-location loader must be taught relative subpaths for adf, outbound_fields, and comment_limits to resolve them at their new adapters/jira/ location while preserving root-module resolution
All surviving dotted and sibling-path imports across adapters/jira/, jira_fields.py, inbound_fields.py, acli_cli_ops.py, and test fixtures must be atomically repointed to the new adapters/jira/ paths
After S4 lands (which routes core imports through the Backend port), no core modules remain as direct importers of the relocated modules
Test targets in categories 2 and 3 (path constants and direct dotted imports) must be rewritten to reference adapters.jira.* paths, while category-1 patch.object sites remain untouched
